text: 30% of Australian adults have high blood
pressure.
This can lead to heart disease, stroke,
and kidney disease, but it's not a life
sentence. High blood pressure can be
prevented or lowered through healthy
life choices.
Here's how to keep your pressure down.
Aim to eat five serves of vegetables and
two serves of fruit each day.
Be active for at least 30 minutes every
day.
Ride, walk,
or try an activity you like.
Quit smoking.
Limit your alcohol intake.
Reduce salty foods. Always check the
food label and choose products with the
least sodium. Maintain a healthy weight.
Make these small changes and have
regular blood pressure checks to keep
your pressure down.
